note: Measured baselines for the PR gate (EVAL.md section 4). A row is claimed by bench + model + provider + prompt_version; `bun scripts/agent-eval.ts --baseline` fails the run when it drops more than one question below `passed`, hits the turn cap at all, or falls below `recall`. Never move a row in the same PR as the change it measures. avg_turns is 1 on every claude-code row because that provider owns its own loop: one qwry turn covers the whole conversation, so turns compare only within a provider (EVAL.md section 6).
